title: 32-bit connection status wrapper

scope.rationale: This dependency-closed unit replaces a bounded public/runtime substitute with the complete active source behavior for 32-bit connection status wrapper.
excluded_responsibilities: Pinned-C internal trace, assurance, and independent review

external_source_responsibilities: Existing exact connection, statement, schema, VFS, allocator, and sqlite3_exec owners
dependencies.caller_closure: Every assigned source body is complete and connected to its exported or internal native caller; adjacent helpers outside the source identities remain separately owned.

inputs: Validated typed owner plus source API parameters
outputs: Exact source state/result and transferred or borrowed output where applicable
contracts.ownership: Connection and statement inputs are borrowed; process allocations transfer to public callers; schema pointers remain schema-owned.
contracts.state_and_results: Success publishes outputs atomically; failures preserve required outputs, result masks, error state, and continuation.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Connection synchronization and callbacks follow the existing typed owner; VFS error lookup and SQL execution are delegated through native interfaces.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: OOM and callback failures release partial ownership and leave valid close/retry state.

representation_differences: Typed Zig slices, optionals, and owner fields replace raw C pointer arithmetic while retaining source lifetime and result behavior.

oracle.protocol: Exercise success, null/empty input, invalid operation or owner, allocation/callback failure, output ownership, and continuation for every assigned function.
oracle.normalization: Compare primary result codes, bytes, counters, masks, and nullability.

assurance.oom: Partial process allocations are released and NOMEM is published without fabricated outputs.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct persistent mutation; connection and VFS synchronization are delegated to native owners.
assurance.malformed_input: Null/invalid owners and operations preserve documented misuse/error behavior.
assurance.continuation: Success and failure both leave owners freeable and reusable as source permits.
assurance.performance: Linear only in returned table or SQL/type bytes; otherwise constant time.

integration.native_call_path: Exported/public runtime entry points and internal consumers invoke the mapped helpers directly.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Prior incomplete inline/stub behavior for the assigned responsibilities is retired.

independent_review.notes: Pinned-C trace, assurance, and independent review remain open.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C internal trace for this unit.
Complete assurance and independent fidelity review.

implementation_spans: Complete pinned source bodies and immediately adjacent ownership helpers
Native mapped bodies, exported callers, tests, and allocation/error owners
callers: Public C-shaped API exports and internal VDBE/schema/runtime consumers
callees: Native allocator, sqlite3_exec, status, tokenizer, VFS, Mem, and schema owners
assertions_branches_cleanup: All source branches, nullability, ownership transfer, cleanup, and result publication assigned
upstream_tests: Upstream API/runtime tests for assigned functions
